video_title: Brandon Jennings on the TRUTH behind Gils Arena and the break up 👀

quotes.speaker: Brandon Jennings
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Jennings on the difficulty of balancing fashion and basketball
quotes.excerpt: It was hard for me to get back into the game of basketball because I was doing fashion.
quotes.quote: It was hard for me to get back into the game of basketball because I was doing fashion. I was just coming off of being with Chris Brown. He is on tour wearing the stuff that I am making. I am like, this is crazy. Then I am doing the Drew League stuff. I was just in Portland working on a Curry collab before I even got on the show.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Jennings
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Jennings on the value of working with Gilbert Arenas
quotes.excerpt: Being able to work with Gilbert Arenas. This is a guy who IQ of the game is crazy.
quotes.quote: Being able to work with Gilbert Arenas. This is a guy who IQ of the game is crazy. Growing up, being from LA and Gilbert Arenas, he lived down the street from me. I am like, oh hell yeah, this is a no-brainer.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Jennings
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Jennings on the loss of vision for the show
quotes.excerpt: We lost focus on the vision of why we were successful.
quotes.quote: I believed in the show. I believed in everything. And then at one point, the plot at the top just got lost. We lost focus on the vision of why we were successful and why we were inspired everybody else to be able to want to do this. Outside noise just started trickling in into us and things from the top just didn't work out the way it was.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Jennings
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Jennings on his post-basketball career opportunities
quotes.excerpt: A lot of good things have come from this. I have got offered to do other shows.
quotes.quote: A lot of good things have come from this. I have got offered to do other shows. My relationship with the Bucks have grown so much because me being on a podcast and being able to do stuff in Milwaukee. Being able to be back in the NBA is cool. It is family.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Jennings
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Jennings on his role and growth on the podcast
quotes.excerpt: When I first came there, I wasn't talking a lot because I'm the youngest one on that podcast.
quotes.quote: When I first came there, I wasn't talking a lot because I'm the youngest one on that podcast. All these guys are vets to me. So I'm an observing person. I'm a Libra, so I'm a chill. I was doing certain things to elevate the show, help the show. I was being a team player. I'm going to make sure we get an interview with Stephen Curry. I'm going to make sure I go to Milwaukee and get some interviews with Giannis. I had Dwyane Wade on the way coming. I had Gil with Kyrie Irving, and we were cooking steaks with Kyrie Irving in his backyard.
